name: stand_up_center_air_rotate
code:
def primitive(obj, target, p):
    cx = obj['center'][0]
    cy = obj['center'][1]
    ayaw = obj['axis_yaw']
    blen = obj['extent_major']
    btop = obj['top_z']
    for _ in range(3):
        ax = cos(ayaw)
        ay = sin(ayaw)
        gx = cx + ax * p['shift']
        gy = cy + ay * p['shift']
        gz = clip(btop - p['grasp_off'], 0.008, 0.3)
        az = gz + p['approach']
        move(gx, gy, az, yaw=ayaw, pitch=0.0, speed=0.2)
        open_gripper()
        move(gx, gy, gz, yaw=ayaw, pitch=0.0, speed=0.12)
        close_gripper(force=25.0)
        if holding():
            move(gx, gy, p['lift_z'], yaw=ayaw, pitch=0.0, speed=0.15)
            move(gx, gy, p['lift_z'], yaw=ayaw, pitch=p['stand_pitch'], speed=0.08)
            pz = blen * 0.5 + abs(p['shift']) + p['place_extra']
            move(gx, gy, pz, yaw=ayaw, pitch=p['stand_pitch'], speed=0.08)
            release()
            retreat(dz=0.08)
            obs = look()
            if obs:
                if obs['height'] > obs['width'] and obs['top_z'] > blen * 0.7:
                    break
                cx = obs['center'][0]
                cy = obs['center'][1]
                ayaw = obs['axis_yaw']
                blen = obs['extent_major']
                btop = obs['top_z']
                if obs['height'] > blen * 0.8:
                    break
            else:
                break
        else:
            retreat(dz=0.05)
            open_gripper()
            obs = look()
            if obs:
                cx = obs['center'][0]
                cy = obs['center'][1]
                ayaw = obs['axis_yaw']
                blen = obs['extent_major']
                btop = obs['top_z']
            else:
                break
description: Pinch the middle of the lying body with hand x along its axis, lift fully into the air, pitch to rotate the body to vertical in the air, then lower its lower end onto the table where it lay. Mid-body airborne rotation and placement differs from end-pivot lifting or open-fork levering.
check: object is tall and narrow with long axis vertical: height > width and top_z near extent_major, versus lying flat and wide

grasp_off.meaning: how far below top_z the tool point pinches the side of the lying body

approach.meaning: clearance height above grasp point for approach

lift_z.meaning: height to lift fully clear of table before rotating in air

stand_pitch.meaning: pitch change to swing mid-grasped body from horizontal to vertical in air

place_extra.meaning: extra tool height above half length when setting lower end on table

shift.meaning: grasp offset along lying axis from center, positive toward axis_yaw direction

lineage.description: stand an object that lies on its side (fallen over) back up on one of its ends, where it lies; its long axis must end vertical
lineage.note: created in the 2026-11-02 Spark evaluation (dry run), added to the user library 2026-11-03
